final: WITH matched AS (SELECT t.telescregistry, t.observstation, t.bandusagepct, o.lunarstage FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation), station_avgs AS (SELECT lunarstage, observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM matched WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation), phase_avgs AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(station_avg) as avg_bandwidth FROM station_avgs GROUP BY lunarstage), phase_counts AS (SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(DISTINCT telescregistry) as telescope_count FROM matched GROUP BY lunarstage), total_count AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT telescregistry) as total FROM matched) SELECT pa.lunarstage as phase, pa.avg_bandwidth, pc.telescope_count, CAST(pc.telescope_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as fraction FROM phase_avgs pa JOIN phase_counts pc ON pa.lunarstage = pc.lunarstage ORDER BY pa.lunarstage
